'''Wilfrid Norman Bailey''' (born 5 September 1893, [[Consett]], [[County Durham|Durham]]; died 23 October 1961, [[Eastbourne]]) was a mathematician who introduced [[Bailey's lemma]] and [[Bailey pair]]s into the theory of [[basic hypergeometric series]]. [[Bailey chain]]s and [[Bailey transform]]s are named after him.
